 │ ✓ Sign in to Candle      │ │  Your agent trades with a key of its own, made by Candle's CLI and stored straight    │ 
 │  Wall…1111 · candle-     │ │  into the Candle Harness. It never shows on screen.                                   │ 
 │                          │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │ ✓ Connect your agent     │ │  Candle won't make a key yet: this account hasn't authorized its embedded wallet for  │ 
 │                          │ │  agents. A new account does this once, on Candle's site.                              │ 
 │ ▸ Wallet and limits      │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │   – a vault, or not      │ │  1  Open the Agent Console (the link below), signed in as this account.               │ 
 │   ▸ its key              │ │  2  Make a key there with Create key and authorize, and approve what Candle asks.     │ 
 │   · its wallet           │ │     That authorizes the wallet.                                                       │ 
 │   · limits               │ │  3  Revoke that key if you like: the authorization stays. Then Try again here.        │ 
 │   · approvals            │ │                                                                                       │ 
 │   · fund it              │ │  ▸ Copy the Agent Console's link                  ⧉ alpha.candle.tv/agents?tab=keys   │ 
 │                          │ │    Try again                                     candle keys create --label agent-a   │
